title: Major Breaking Change: Data Catalog V1 API Surface Significantly Reduced
summary: The Data Catalog V1 API has undergone a substantial breaking change, with numerous methods and schema properties removed. Developers relying on entry groups, entries, tags, and tag templates will need to update their integrations.
details: This update introduces a significant breaking change to the Data Catalog V1 API. A large portion of the API surface has been removed, impacting core functionalities related to managing metadata. Specifically, all methods for `entryGroups`, `entries`, `tags`, and `tagTemplates` have been removed, including operations like `create`, `delete`, `get`, `list`, `patch`, `setIamPolicy`, `testIamPermissions`, `lookup`, `import`, `modifyEntryContacts`, `modifyEntryOverview`, `star`, `unstar`, and `reconcile`. Additionally, many properties from key schemas such as `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1EntryGroup`, `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1FieldType`, `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1TagTemplate`, and `GoogleCloudDatacatalogV1TagTemplateField` have been removed. Developers should carefully review their existing integrations and migrate to alternative solutions or newer API versions if available, as these functionalities are no longer supported in `datacatalog.v1`.
